BG_008.name: Thistledown Millpond
BG_008.prompt: a still millpond with big round lily pads, cattail reeds, glowing water reflections, a wooden windmill on the bank and the stone church spire behind, a little arched footbridge

variants.NIGHT: deep-indigo night, silver moonlight reflections on the water
variants.TORN_SKY: night, but a thin glowing seam of daylight splits the sky above the pond

BG_007.name: Thistledown Night Sky Over Rooftops
BG_007.prompt: a sweeping night sky above the sleeping rooftops of Thistledown, thatched and tiled roofs, chimneys, the windmill and church spire silhouetted, soft rolling clouds and many twinkling stars

variants.DAWN: indigo melting into pink and gold at the horizon
